meta.title: doocs/md
meta.description: Turns Markdown into WeChat Official Account HTML with the doocs/md engine, including KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, callout alerts and the editor's themes. Call md_wechat_render with an output path to get a ready-to-publish HTML file, and call md_wechat_options to list the available themes, colours and spacing presets. Rendering runs inside the Harness process and needs no network access unless you ask for a code-block theme.
